title: scREAD: A Single-Cell RNA-Seq Database for Alzheimer's Disease
reason: Paper describes scREAD database aggregating 55 existing scRNA-seq/snRNA-seq datasets from AD studies. No specific accession numbers provided; code repository available but data access is through the database portal. No new data generated, so low score for integration benchmark that requires explicit dataset IDs and batch information.
methods_summary: The authors developed scREAD, a database that provides comprehensive analysis results for 55 single-cell/nucleus RNA-seq datasets from human AD postmortem brain and mouse models, including control atlas construction, cell type prediction, differential expression, and regulon identification.
